label: Cubes as strings of 0, 1 and dash
section: Cubes as strings of 0, 1 and dash
subgoals: Write each variable as 1, 0 or a dash in its position
Count 2 to the number of dashes for the cube size
Intersect position by position, with a 0 against a 1 emptying the result

label: Distance between cubes
subgoals: Compare the two cubes position by position
Count positions with 0 in one cube and 1 in the other
Read distance 0 as intersecting and distance 1 as mergeable or consensus

label: Consensus of distance-one cubes
subgoals: Find the single variable in which the two cubes conflict
Drop that variable and intersect the remaining positions
Count the literals of the resulting consensus cube
